title: Domain History Contact OSINT Output
description: A per-domain intelligence report sectioned by the checkboxes you ticked, plus a separate contacts table with per-contact provenance.

domainReports.title: Domain Reports
domainReports.description: One row per domain. Always populated even when the domain is dead. The report contains a status block (always present), a results object with one key per ticked checkbox (contacts, ownership, subdomains, hosting, old_pages, server_tech, tracking_ids, mentions), and a coverage object explaining which sections came back complete and which had gaps.

contacts.title: Contacts With Provenance
contacts.description: One row per contact per source. Emails, phones, people and organisations, each with sourceUrl, snapshotTimestamp, extractionMethod, confidence and a full sightings array. This is the evidence-grade output. Only populated when the 'Emails and phone numbers' checkbox is ticked.
